caption: Paid plans include 500, 2,000 or unlimited FAQ page views, with extra views at $0.0075 and extra AI chats at $0.30. Each part is capped at $7.99, $14.99 or $49.99 a month. Free covers 100 page views.
We switched FAQ Schema on in Settings and the card changed to On. We did not check whether the structured data reached the live page.
Our first two FAQs had no group, and the app page /a/faqs said Sorry, No FAQs found. FAQs without a group do not show. The store name is hidden.
Once we made the group Shipping and returns and put a third FAQ in it, the question and answer showed up, about 4 minutes after install. The store name is hidden.
Shopify's approval screen for Professional monthly: $7.99 with 40% off the first charge, so $4.79, and usage charges of up to $15.98 per 30 days. We did not approve it.
